tasks.question: What is the total order value per customer country?
tasks.gold: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_cents) FROM {schema}.eval_orders AS o JOIN {schema}.eval_customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

tasks.question: Show customers with more than 2 orders.
tasks.gold: SELECT c.name FROM {schema}.eval_customers AS c JOIN {schema}.eval_orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

tasks.question: Which three orders have the highest totals, largest first?

tasks.question: Which customers have never ordered?
